entities.name: Cécile Mendelssohn Bartholdy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cécile Sophie Charlotte Mendelssohn Bartholdy was a German amateur artist and singer of French descent. As the wife of composer Felix Mendelssohn, she is often seen as a positive influence on his life and work and is the dedicatee of music by both Felix and his sister Fanny Mendelssohn.
